validation.notes: Fault: migrateAuthToAuthJson() in packages/coding-agent/src/migrations.ts parsed legacy oauth.json with JSON.parse(readFileSync(oauthPath, "utf-8")) while every other JSON reader in the package (settings.json, keybindings.json, themes, models) goes through stripBom(). A UTF-8 BOM therefore made JSON.parse throw, the catch swallowed the error, oauth.json was never renamed and auth.json was never written, so existing OAuth credentials silently stopped migrating on startup. Fix (one line, minimal): parse JSON.parse(stripBom(readFileSync(oauthPath, "utf-8"))) using the already-imported utils/text.ts stripBom helper. No control flow, precedence, or file-lifecycle behavior was changed: OAuth entries are still written first as {type:'oauth',...cred}, settings.json apiKeys are still only used as a fallback for providers not already migrated, auth.json is still skipped when it already exists, and the oauth.json -> oauth.json.migrated rename still happens only after a successful parse, so malformed input is left untouched. Regression (.prale-eval/regression.mjs, run from the workspace root with `node --experimental-vm-modules .prale-eval/regression.mjs`, exit 0, 6 checks) loads the real production module through .prale-eval/subject.mjs loadMigrations() with the real fs/path modules and only getAgentDir/stripBom faked, using throwaway agent dirs under .prale-eval/.tmp that are removed afterwards. It asserts: (1) BOM-prefixed oauth.json migrates -> providers ['anthropic'], auth.json == {anthropic:{type:'oauth',access,refresh,expires}} with mode 0600, oauth.json renamed away and oauth.json.migrated byte-identical to the original file; (2) plain BOM-less oauth.json still migrates; (3) BOM-prefixed settings.json apiKeys still migrate as {type:'api_key',key} with unrelated settings preserved and apiKeys removed; (4) OAuth precedence: same provider in oauth.json and settings.json apiKeys keeps the OAuth credential and only the remaining provider becomes an api_key; (5) malformed (truncated) oauth.json is preserved byte for byte, is not renamed, and produces no auth.json; (6) an existing auth.json is never overwritten and suppresses the migration entirely. Results from the VM realm are normalized before deep comparison to avoid cross-realm Array prototype mismatches. Verified by reverting the one-line fix: the script then exits 1 with AssertionError 'BOM-prefixed oauth.json must report migrated providers' (actual [] vs expected ['anthropic']), i.e. it fails on this stage's original fault rather than on a runtime or import error; with the fix restored it exits 0. `node --experimental-strip-types --check packages/coding-agent/src/migrations.ts` also parses cleanly. Limitation: repository dependencies are not installed in this workspace (no node_modules) and installing them is out of scope, so the package's own vitest suite and tsc/biome type/lint checks could not be executed; validation relies on the VM-based regression plus the Node syntax check.
